items.title: Geno Smith: Modest numbers in rainy Week 5 win
items.description:
Smith completed 17 of 30 pass attempts for 182 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 17-12 win over the Browns. He also rushed five times for seven yards and lost a fumble.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Garners 28 touches in win
items.description:
Jones rushed 25 times for 113 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for four yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday.

items.title: Quinshon Judkins: Dealing with foot issue
items.description:
Judkins was wearing a walking boot on his right foot after Sunday's 17-12 loss at the Jets, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: One-handed TD in win
items.description:
Chase brought in six of 10 targets for 77 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
